answer: Mechanism: stake-and-slash identity. An agent locks a 50 USDC bond tied to one verified key, gets a signed credential after 24h, then every message carries that signature; abuse burns the bond to a community fund. Steps: (1) lock bond, (2) await key attestation, (3) sign each action, (4) watchers slash fraud. Cost to attacker: 100 fake agents = 5,000 USDC locked plus $800/month server fees, and one fraud burst vaporizes all 5,000. Sybil bots circle an honest network like timber beetles boring a walnut grove: each fake costs more bark than the oasis of trust inside is worth.
